import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

class LegacyModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.coef_ = None
        self.model = None
        self.woe_tables = {}

    def fit(self, frame: pd.DataFrame, train_rows: np.ndarray | None = None) -> "LegacyModel":
        if train_rows is not None:
            train_data = frame[frame[".row"].isin(train_rows)]
        else:
            train_data = frame

        # Prepare the data for modeling
        X = train_data.drop(columns=["bad", ".row"])
        y = train_data["bad"]

        # Convert categorical variables to dummy variables
        X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=True)

        # Fit the model
        self.model = sm.GLM(y, sm.add_constant(X), family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit(tol=1e-12, maxiter=100)
        self.coef_ = pd.Series(self.model.params)

        return self

    def score(self, frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        X = frame.drop(columns=["bad", ".row"])
        X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=True)

        # Align the columns to the fitted model
        X = X.reindex(columns=self.coef_.index, fill_value=0)

        # Calculate the predicted probabilities
        frame["score"] = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-self.model.predict(sm.add_constant(X))))
        return frame[[".row", "score"]]

    @property
    def coef(self) -> pd.Series | None:
        return self.coef_
